{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Based on the Ukrainian text in your case ("стриманий робочий день в офісі" meaning a streamlined workday at the office) and the specified season of autumn, here is the styled outfit. The formality level for a professional office setting in autumn is **neat**, which accommodates trousers or a skirt paired with a refined knit and ankle boots.

Refined Knit Sweater
Relaxed fit silhouette, mid-length hitting at the hipbone, charcoal gray color (#36454F), soft merino wool blend with subtle texture.
Straight-leg Wool Trousers
Classic cut, full length reaching the ankle bone, deep navy blue color (#0A1929), structured virgin wool for warmth and drape.
Leather Ankle Boots
Pointed toe shape, mid-calf height just above the malleolus, oxblood red color (#741313), smooth calfskin leather with a low block heel.

This ensemble works perfectly for an autumn office day because the refined knit and wool trousers provide the necessary warmth against cooler temperatures while maintaining a polished professional silhouette. The dark, neutral base of the sweater and pants creates a streamlined look that honors your request to avoid anything bright or flashy. Finally, the oxblood boots add a sophisticated pop of deep color that grounds the outfit without overwhelming it, ensuring you feel comfortable yet put-together throughout your workday."}
